Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model - which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

As a Senior Value Engineer specializing in Banking , you are at the forefront of solving business-critical problems for some of the world's largest financial institutions. You will work intimately with strategic enterprise clients to understand their complex objectives-ranging from accelerating Loan Origination and Client Onboarding to optimizing Capital Markets Operations and Regulatory Reporting .

You will build Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with top AI and ML technology partners. By feeding operational context to AI, you help banks understand the intricate realities of their massive transactional ecosystems. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Banking Executives (COOs, CROs, and Heads of Digital Transformation), and ensure successful implementation and value realization to solidify and expand the Celonis footprint across the global financial landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

• AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand the clients' overarching AI strategies and the distinct challenges inherent to Banking (e.g., fraud detection, credit risk assessment, and automating KYC/AML). Translate complex financial workflows into innovative AI solutions that drive measurable ROI.

• Pre- and Post-Sales Execution: Actively drive the customer lifecycle. Lead technical discovery and capability demonstrations during the expansion cycle. Remain deeply involved post-sale to guide implementation, ensuring efficiency and adoption thresholds are met.

• Hackathons & Prototyping: Think creatively to tackle heavily siloed legacy core-banking systems. Leverage cutting-edge AI to rapidly build prototypes in client hackathons, solving pain points across Settlements, Reconciliations, and Payments.

• Agentic Process Transformation: Support enterprise clients in shifting from rule-based automation to autonomous AI agents. Enable "intelligent" banking processes, such as autonomous exception handling in Trade Ops or automated Complaints Management .

• Proof Projects: Execute end-to-end Business-critical Proof-of-Value projects. Architect secure, scalable LLM/agent systems (with RAG and guardrails) that integrate with complex enterprise stacks like SAP Banking, Salesforce FINS, or core-banking ledgers.

• Domain Practitioner Leadership: Serve as a functional subject matter expert for the Banking value chain, scaling knowledge across the organization regarding the nuances of financial operations and transaction lifecycles.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales and post-sales engagements specifically within complex Banking or Financial Services environments. This includes building ROI business cases and guiding technical implementations.

• Strong Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the banking value chain, with the ability to translate operational needs into AI use cases across:

• Lending & Onboarding: Loan Origination, KYC/AML, and Banking & Lending.

• Capital Markets: Sales & Trading Ops, Settlements, Reconciliations, and Custody Services.

• Support & Governance: Finance, Risk & Controls, and Regulatory/Transaction Reporting.

• Expertise in Generative AI Techniques

title: Senior Director, Patient Advocacy & Communications Lead, EMEA
description:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.
As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.
 
Summary of Position:

The Patient Advocacy & Corporate Communications Lead, EMEA will be responsible for developing and executing integrated patient advocacy and communications strategies that advance the company's mission, strengthen stakeholder trust, and support business objectives across the region, starting with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) and including  facioscapulohumeral dystrophy (FSHD) in line with clinical development milestones. 

This role will serve as the primary EMEA lead for patient advocacy engagement while also driving corporate and product communications, executive visibility, disease awareness initiatives, and internal communications. The successful candidate will engage the SMA community (and communities for future disease states) to establish and solidify trust and act as a connector to patient and advocate perspectives to drive Scholar Rock’s patient first values. They will act as a trusted strategic advisor to regional leadership and work cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Global patient advocacy and communications, Market Access, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and Commercial Teams, supported by global and regional agency partners.

The ideal candidate combines deep understanding of the rare disease community with exceptional communications and stakeholder management capabilities and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial biotech environment.
 
 
 
Position Responsibilities 

Scholar Rock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Backend Engineer | Token Spend Management
description:

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp’s Token Spend Management team helps finance and technical teams understand and manage what they spend across AI providers and subscriptions. We are building the third pillar https://ramp.com/blog/ramp-at-44-billion-the-third-pillar of finance. The product brings provider usage and billing information together so customers can see where costs come from, attribute spend, and act on it with greater confidence.

We’re looking for a senior backend engineer to build the systems behind that experience. You’ll own substantial projects from design through production, turn data from different providers into dependable product experiences, and work with product, design, data, and engineering partners to make complex spend information useful to customers. You will be involved in key company initiatives such as inference accounting, and figuring out new and novel ways to help companies not just manage, but think about their AI Spend.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design and build backend services and APIs that support AI spend visibility, attribution, insights, and controls

- Build and improve integrations that ingest usage and billing information from supported providers

- Taking the data from those integrations and converting it into helpful structures for external customers, and internal product consumers

- Create reliable data models and processing workflows that make spend information accurate, traceable, and useful across the product

- Own projects from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

- Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of systems as customer usage and provider coverage grow

- Partner with product, design, data, and engineering teammates to turn customer needs into practical solutions

- Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- Strong judgment about system design, data correctness, reliability, and when to keep a solution simple

- A track record of independently owning complex projects and shipping high-quality software

- Experience working with external data sources or integrations where data quality and changing interfaces matter

- Comfort working through ambiguous product problems with cross-functional partners

- Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions and feedback

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience with usage metering, billing, spend management, or financial data products

- Experience integrating with AI providers or other third-party usage and billing APIs

- Experience building attribution, alerts, limits, or other systems that help customers understand and manage spend

title: Payroll Specialist, EMEA
description:
About Remote People

At Remote People , we're building the infrastructure to power borderless teams . By handling global payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance, our technology enables businesses to hire anyone anywhere compliantly at the push of a button.

If you're interested in adding to our vision of enabling people to work in dream jobs, for every company, and from anywhere in the world , apply now!

We're committed to building a global, diverse team representing different and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability. Being part of Remote People means being part of a growing, international family.

Position overview:
We’re looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Specialist to join our global payroll team and support the accurate and timely delivery of payroll across multiple countries.
This is a hands-on operational role focused on payroll processing, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution. You’ll work closely with internal teams and payroll partners to review payroll results, investigate discrepancies, and ensure accurate outputs for our clients and employees.
You don’t need to be an expert in every country we support. We’re looking for someone with strong payroll fundamentals, experience managing payroll for at least one country, and the ability to quickly understand new payroll requirements and processes.
Key Responsibilities:

• Support end-to-end payroll processing and validation for multiple countries.

• Collect, review, and validate payroll inputs and outputs.

• Perform payroll reconciliations and identify discrepancies between expected and final results.

• Investigate payroll differences and work with internal teams or payroll partners to understand and resolve them.

• Support payroll changes including new hires, terminations, salary changes, bonuses, deductions, and leave.

• Review payroll calculations and supporting information for accuracy.

• Communicate with internal payroll teams and external partners to resolve payroll questions.

• Maintain accurate payroll records, documentation, and trackers.

• Work with payroll technology and automated validation tools to improve accuracy and efficiency.

• Learn and support additional countries as our global payroll operations continue to evolve.

Qualifications:

• Previous hands-on payroll experience, ideally including in-house payroll processing.

• Experience managing payroll for at least one country independently.

• Strong understanding of payroll inputs, calculations, validations, reconciliations, and outputs.

• Ability to investigate discrepancies and understand why payroll results have changed.

• Strong attention to detail and confidence working with payroll data and numbers.

• Comfortable using payroll systems, Excel/Google Sheets, and automated tools.

• Strong English communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams and payroll partners.

• Comfortable learning new systems and adapting to evolving payroll processes.

Nice to have:

• Payroll experience in one or more of the following countries: France, Netherlands, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy, or Spain.

• Experience with Romania or Austria payroll.

• Experience managing payroll across multiple countries.

• Exposure to additional European or African payroll jurisdictions.

• Experience with payroll platforms or systems such as ADP or similar tools.

• Experience using automated payroll validation, reconciliation, or AI-enabled tools.

Our service & product . We're a technology company, not an accountancy, payroll provider, recruitment firm or similar. We build a workforce management platform that allows our customers to hire the best talent in minutes, without worrying about compliance, payroll, or HR admin.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform.

What you'll be working on:

- Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.

- Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries.

- Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles.

- Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal.

- Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models.

- Ensuring scalability, security, observability, and resilience in production.

- Continuously improving shared libraries, project structure, development tooling, and automated quality assurance practices to promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across services.

- Driving architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and mentoring other engineers.

- Leveraging AI extensively but responsibly, including developing guardrails, agent harnesses, and tooling to maintain engineering quality in a fast-paced environment.

We primarily use Node.js with TypeScript, but strong engineering fundamentals matter more to us than experience with a particular language. Our technology stack also includes Temporal, SpiceDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis.

This is a 80/20 hands-on technical leadership role, combining deep engineering work with architectural ownership and influence across teams.
Remote, but travel to Amsterdam or other offsite meetings in Europe might occasionally be requested

YOUR COLLEAGUES WOULD SAY YOU

- Lead by example and raise the bar with pragmatism and care.

- Communicate clearly, listen well, and bring people along in decisions.

- Enjoy breaking down complex problems, gathering input, and driving to a solution.

- Coach others and create space for people to grow.

- Prefer progress over perfection, while still caring deeply about quality.

 

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us - with catering in our Lisbon, Copenhagen and London offices or a monthly lunch allowance paid directly together with your salary in other markets

- Private health insurance to ensure you’re fit in body and mind to do your best work

- Wellbeing days - fully paid days off designed for a slower pace, allowing you to take time to recharge and prioritise self-care

- We provide access to MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and wellbeing support with great success so far

title: Senior Manager, Technical Revenue supporting MongoDB
description:
Sustainable Talent is partnering with MongoDB, a global leader in data solutions, powering innovation with a flexible platform that helps businesses build and grow modern applications. We are looking for a Senior Manager, Technical Revenue to support our clients growing Revenue team!
This is a full-time (W-2) contract role based in the US with a 100% Remote work model. We offer competitive pay based on factors like experience, education, location, etc. and provide full benefits, PTO, and amazing company culture!
Reporting to the Director of Technical Revenue, the Senior Manager, Technical Revenue will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor to Product, GTM, Deal Strategy, Legal, and FP&A, influencing how MongoDB recognizes revenue on its newest products, pricing models, and most complex commercial deals. This is a highly visible role at the intersection of product, deal strategy, technical accounting, and requires strong business acumen and a deep understanding of MongoDB's products and deal terms. This role will help shape our revenue recognition policy under ASC 606, not just apply it, as the business scales.
What you'll do:

• Evaluate revenue accounting implications of new products, pricing and packaging changes, partner/channel arrangements, strategic transactions, and go-to-market initiatives; prepare technical accounting memos, position papers, and related documentation as needed.

• Act as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor to cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, FP&A, Pricing and Packaging, Product, and GTM leadership) on revenue recognition implications of commercial strategy, deal structures, and new offerings.

• Proactively engage early in business initiatives to shape outcomes upstream, ensuring revenue accounting considerations are embedded in decision making rather than addressed reactively.

• Serve as the company’s subject matter expert on ASC 606 for Software/SaaS arrangements, including variable consideration, contract modifications, and material right assessments.

• Review contract write-ups to ensure that revenue is recognized in accordance with ASC606.

• Support accounting systems and process improvement initiatives, particularly those related to scalability and continued company growth automation, and AI-enabled workflows .

What we need to see:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting (CA/CPA preferred) with a Big 4 background and at least 7+ years of experience in a similar role at public, high-growth SaaS or technology company.

• Deep expertise in ASC 606, technical revenue accounting, including complex contract structures, variable consideration, and policy interpretation in evolving commercial environments.

• Ability to influence stakeholders, simplify complex issues, make sound decisions in fast-moving environments, and translate technical and operational issues into clear recommendations.

• Must be self-motivated, flexible, deadline-oriented, and have the ability to independently drive projects to completion.

• Excellent time management skills and ability to work in a fast paced environment.

About Sustainable Talent

Sustainable Talent is a certified woman-owned company specializing in recruitment, consulting, and workforce solutions. We partner with innovative organizations to connect exceptional talent with meaningful opportunities across technology, engineering, operations, and professional services.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Sustainable Talent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

title: GRC Analyst
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a GRC Analyst to join our Compliance & Security team and help make risk management, audit and compliance a continuous part of how Supabase runs. You’ll work closely with engineering, security, IT, and legal to help us define our risk tolerance, keep our compliance programs (including SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022) current, test controls on a rolling basis, and answer customer and vendor security reviews quickly and accurately.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Run risk assessments across the company and major product changes. Score likelihood and impact, propose treatments, and bring the results to leadership to inform risk tolerance decisions.

- Maintain the risk register, track remediation to closure, and report status to compliance and security leadership.

- Monitor controls on a rolling basis, using automated tests where they exist and manual testing where they don’t. Triage failures, prioritize by the risk register, and align each finding with an owner and a due date.

- Support internal audit, whether performed by an external partner or in-house: propose scope from the risk register, supply evidence, and track findings to closure.

- Run day-to-day operations for our compliance programs: evidence collection, control owner follow-up, and readiness ahead of each audit period.

- Extend continuous control validation beyond what our compliance platform covers. Build custom tests with AI coding tools, work with engineering and IT to pull evidence from source systems instead of collecting screenshots, and check that each test proves what the control requires.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 3+ years of experience in GRC, internal audit, or security compliance at a SaaS or technology company

- Are comfortable working with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, a compliance platform such as Drata, Vanta, and evidence from systems like AWS, GCP, Google Workspace, and Okta

- Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences

- Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

- Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support-not replace-existing tools

title: Engineering Manager - Consumer
description:
Plaid Link is the front door to modern financial experiences. It securely connects people’s financial accounts to the apps and services they trust, and it’s the foundation Plaid’s product teams build onboarding, payments, identity, and lending experiences on. Link supports more than 12,000 financial institutions and 9,000+ apps and services, is used by roughly one in two adults with a bank account, and is the starting point for approximately 750,000 connections every day.

The Unified Link team is now focused on building a single onboarding platform for Plaid’s products. Customers will integrate once through a single API and turn on additional products with a toggle in the dashboard, making it easy to adopt new capabilities and expand their use of Plaid.

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead roughly ten engineers through a major transformation: bringing our existing onboarding products together, moving Link’s highest-traffic experiences onto the new foundation without disrupting the traffic they carry every day, and continuing to improve the Link experience along the way. You’ll partner closely with a Principle Engineer and the team’s Tech Lead to set technical direction and sequence the migration, and with Product, Design, and teams across Plaid to make the platform easy to adopt and extend. All while maintaining a high bar for quality and reliability, and growing your engineers through clear priorities, coaching, and feedback.

Responsibilities

- Set team strategy and the technical roadmap in partnership with the Tech Lead, balancing the platform migration with ongoing improvements to Link

- Drive team execution (planning, sprints, delivery) and hold a high technical bar through hands-on involvement in design and code review

- Hire, manage, and develop a team of engineers, including goal setting, coaching, feedback, and performance management

- Partner with Product, Design, and engineering teams across Plaid to define clear interfaces and make the unified platform easy to adopt and extend

- Keep Link reliable and healthy through the transition, making sound tradeoffs between new work and long-term system health

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience as a backend or full-stack engineer, with a track record of designing and shipping complex, scalable systems

- 2+ years managing engineers, including coaching, performance management, and building a team

- Strong technical depth: you can dive into architecture and design details, and credibly hold a high bar for the team

- Strong user empathy and the ability to balance technical tradeoffs with product outcomes

- Nice to have: experience building consumer-facing products and/or product led growth (PLG) dev tools

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Retrieval & Targeting
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Team Description:
The Ads Retrieval ML team builds the machine learning systems that identify relevant advertising candidates for Reddit users. Retrieval sits at the heart of the ads delivery funnel: before downstream ranking and auction decisions, our models determine which campaigns and ads are eligible to compete. We work on large-scale retrieval across multiple objectives, placements, and geographies. Our work combines representation learning, candidate generation, nearest-neighbor search, behavioral and contextual signals, and rigorous offline and online experimentation.
Role Description:
We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to provide technical leadership for the Retrieval and Targeting ML team. You will lead the design and evolution of retrieval models and modeling practices that improve relevance, advertiser outcomes, and user experience at Reddit scale. This is an applied ML role centered on retrieval modeling and end-to-end product impact. You will be expected to stay close to the technical details-from data and objective design through model development, evaluation, experimentation, and launch-while setting direction for other engineers.
Responsibilities:

• Define the technical direction and multi-year roadmap for ads retrieval modeling in partnership with engineering, product, data science, and ads stakeholders.

• Design, develop, and launch candidate-generation and retrieval models for campaigns and ads across Reddit ’s advertising surfaces.

• Apply modern approaches such as two-tower architectures, representation learning, embeddings, sequence models, graph-based methods, and other deep learning techniques when they create meaningful product value.

• Improve the retrieval stack across key modeling decisions, including objectives, labels, sampling strategies, hard-negative mining, feature design, embedding generation, candidate filtering, and retrieval depth.

• Work with approximate nearest-neighbor and vector retrieval systems, reasoning about recall, relevance, freshness, diversity, coverage, latency, and cost trade-offs.

• Establish strong evaluation practices that connect retrieval metrics-such as recall, precision, candidate coverage, calibration, and downstream lift-to ads and user outcomes.

• Lead offline analysis and online experiments, interpret ambiguous results, and translate findings into the next modeling iteration.

• Partner with downstream ranking, ads platform, auction, measurement, and product teams to ensure retrieval models integrate effectively into the full ads funnel.

• Write design documents, review code and model changes, and raise the quality bar for modeling, testing, observability, and production ownership.

• Mentor ML engineers and help grow the team’s expertise in retrieval, recommendation, and representation learning.

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of industry experience, including substantial experience building and shipping applied ML products.

• Deep experience with information retrieval, candidate generation, recommender systems, ranking, or related relevance problems.

• Strong understanding of retrieval modeling concepts, including DNN, embeddings, two-tower or dual-encoder models, approximate nearest-neighbor search, and multi-stage retrieval.

• Deep experience training, evaluating, debugging, and deploying deep learning models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.

• Demonstrated ownership of ML projects from problem framing and data preparation through offline evaluation, online experimentation, prod

title: Co-Op, Robot Perception & State Estimation
description:
Your Impact at LILA

As a Co-Op on the Production Robotics team at Lila Sciences, you will help build the algorithms and software that let our robots know where they are and what they are looking at, so they can run scientific workflows reliably inside the AI Science Factories (AISFs). The team develops the state estimation, perception, and testing infrastructure that general-purpose robotic skills depend on.

Your work will sit at the intersection of estimation, computer vision, and robotics software. You will help improve how our mobile bases estimate their position and motion, develop camera-based detection and localization of AprilTags and lab instruments, and strengthen the simulation-based testing and CI that validate changes before they reach hardware. Expect a mix of writing production-quality software, applying math to real sensor data, and debugging real-world behavior on physical robots.

You will work alongside robotics engineers, AI researchers, and software engineers, with day-to-day support from the Production Robotics team. The output is software that runs in production lab environments and directly accelerates the rate at which Lila can run experiments.

What You'll Be Building

• Fuse multi-sensor data to improve mobile base state estimation

• Build camera-based AprilTag and instrument detection and localization for robot manipulation and navigation

• Develop new robot capabilities in ROS 2 (Jazzy)

• Expand simulation-based tests and CI pipelines so changes are validated before deployment on hardware

• Evaluate estimation and perception performance on real robot data and contribute fixes back to the codebase

• Ship production code alongside robotics, software, and AI engineers

• Document algorithms, test approaches, and integration patterns for the rest of the team

What You'll Need to Succeed

• In-progress Master's (preferred) or strong senior-year Bachelor's in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a controls/estimation leaning

• Proficiency in Python and/or C++, with coursework or project experience writing well-tested code

• Familiarity with state estimation and sensor fusion (e.g., Kalman filtering)

• Strong foundation in linear algebra and probability

• Comfort with Git and Linux development environments

• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across a multidisciplinary team

• Available for the full spring co-op term

Bonus Points For

• Experience with ROS 2 (Jazzy preferred) or another robotics framework

• Hands-on experience with camera systems and computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, AprilTags, camera calibration)

• Experience with simulation-based testing and CI (e.g., Gazebo, GitHub Actions)

• Experience integrating software with sensors, actuators, or other physical systems

• Coursework or projects in localization, SLAM, or robot control

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About the role

We're looking for a senior Partner Manager to own and grow a portfolio of Middesk's most strategic partners. These are fintech and B2B platforms (identity, risk, fraud and onboarding providers) that embed, resell or refer Middesk to their customers. Partnerships influence a meaningful share of Middesk's revenue, and this role is responsible for growing it.

You'll be the main owner of each partner relationship, from executive alignment through to the commercial terms and the day-to-day work of getting shared customers live. That means growing usage across partners' customer bases, running a real co-sell motion with our sales team, and structuring partnerships so both sides are invested in growing together. You'll join a small team and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering and Customer Success.

We follow a hybrid work model, and this role is expected in our SF or NYC office 3 days per week. Candidates should be within commuting distance.

- Grow usage across shared customers. Work with Marketing and the partner's team on campaigns and enablement that get more of their customers live on Middesk and using more of our products.

- Run the co-sell motion. Work with AEs and SEs on partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals, following our co-selling rules of engagement, and help partners bring us into the right deals early.

- Lead commercial conversations. Negotiate expansions, pricing and renewals. Sell the full value of Middesk, and structure gives-and-gets that reward growth on both sides.

- Bring partner insight back to Middesk. Share what partners and their customers need with Product, and help shape roadmap and integration priorities.

- Own and improve the partner playbook. Run account planning, QBRs, enablement and performance tracking, and improve them as the function scales.

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Firegang Dental Marketing is a digital marketing company headquartered in Spokane, Washington that has been in business for over 10 years. Our clients are primarily dentists and our service packages include website design, paid ad management, SEO, analytics, copywriting, and more.
A successful Client Success Manager (CSM) will enjoy working directly with dentists to develop websites and digital marketing strategies that will work toward the client’s goals in their market. • Answer client emails, phone calls, and other communications in a timely manner.

• At least 4 year of relevant Account Management experience required.

• Dental Experience required.

• Digital Marketing required.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Data driven and enjoy helping clients succeed.

• Team oriented and a problem solver.

• Enjoy professional conversations with clients and co-workers.

Bonus Points For:

• Experience with Google AdWords, Google Analytics, and/or any other online marketing solutions and you enjoy digging into data to address problems and identify solutions.
Benefits:

• Salary of $42-48k/year DOE

• PPO Health Benefits (medical/dental)

• 401K Option with matching

• Generous PTO and Holiday Schedule

• 100% Telecommute

• Life, AD&D, Short, and Long Term Disability Insurances

title: Country Manager - Merchant
description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken - you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our Country Manager - Merchant, you’ll play a key role in driving sales and profitable growth across Satispay’s core merchant business.

You will hold the strategic and operational responsibility, including the P&L (profit and loss), for our core merchant ecosystem, the most iconic and foundational business we have. Your mission is to maximize sales, find new ways to monetize, lead our commercial teams, and be the strongest advocate for merchants’ needs and market trends. This is a permanent role based in Milan, with a flexible hybrid working policy.

This is an opportunity to lead within a high-growth, constantly evolving environment - a challenge perfectly suited for an executive ready to navigate and shape change at scale and contribute to something bigger.

Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

- Own the Merchant P&L and strategy - Define, drive, and execute the commercial strategy for the Merchant business, delivering sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

- Lead and scale the sales teams - Directly manage and mentor the sales organization. Sharpen commercial processes, targets, and performance to maximize market penetration.

- Be the voice of the merchant - Dig into merchants’ needs, pain points, and industry trends, and turn them into clear, actionable feedback for our product and growth strategies.

- Spot monetization opportunities - Keep analyzing the merchant landscape to identify, test, and launch new feature-driven or service-driven ways to monetize.

- Thrive in a matrix structure - Work closely with cross-functional teams, such as Product and Growth, among others, to align the product roadmap with merchant expectations and make execution seamless.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who we're looking for

This role needs a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors.
You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results, and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment.

- Business acumen and P&L ownership - 5-8+ years in senior leadership roles (General Manager, Head of Business or VP of Sales) with full accountability for a business line’s P&L, ideally scaling merchant-facing or business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C) business lines.

- Sales leadership - Proven experience directly managing, structuring, and motivating high-performing sales teams, preferably in Fintech, Payments, Retail Tech, or Marketplace, backed by a strong commercial drive. Experience and expertise in acquiring, payment acceptance, and point-of-sale (POS) solutions is a plus.

- Monetization and growth mindset - A sharp eye for untapped revenue streams, upselling opportunities, and strategic partnerships within a merchant ecosystem.

- Matrix organization expertise - Strong ability to navigate and influence in a matrix environment, bridging the gap between field sales and central product and growth teams.

- Customer-centric, trend-driven

title: Claims Adjuster, Litigation (AV)
description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

The AV Litigation Adjuster manages suits arising from autonomous and driver-assist vehicle incidents from the day of service through resolution. AV suits often add product-liability and technology claims to a standard negligence case, so the role directs defense counsel, controls discovery of sensitive technical data, and drives early, well-supported resolution.

What you'll do

• Manage the litigation inventory: assign and direct defense counsel, approve plans and budgets, and review bills against guidelines

• Build the liability and damages case with counsel using vehicle data, video, software and sensor records, and expert input, while coordinating discovery and preservation holds that protect proprietary technical information

• Retain and manage experts, including accident reconstruction, AV systems and human-factors, medical, and economic specialists

• Evaluate exposure, set reserves, and prepare reserve and settlement recommendations for carrier and client review

• Attend mediations, settlement conferences, and trial as needed, negotiating resolution within authority and pursuing contribution, indemnity, and subrogation against manufacturers, suppliers, and other parties

• Track emerging AV case law, state statutes, and regulatory developments, and report on inventory, trends, and key cases to the Team Lead and client partners

Who you are

• Detailed understanding of the SAE J3016 levels of driving automation (Levels 0-5), including how driver-assist (Levels 0-2) and driverless (Levels 3-5) systems shift responsibility among the human, the system, and the operator

• Determine who or what was in control at the time of loss: human driver, driver-assist feature, or automated driving system

• Request, preserve, and read AV evidence, including telematics, event data, camera and sensor footage, remote-assistance logs, and software version

• Apply coverage, liability, and damages analysis across fleet-operator, manufacturer, supplier, and third-party exposures

• Work with AV operator safety, legal, and risk teams under tight response timelines while meeting federal and state crash-reporting, privacy, and data-handling requirements

• Document files so a supervisor, carrier, or auditor can follow the liability decision

Qualifications

• 6-8+ years of litigated casualty claims experience; commercial auto, rideshare, trucking, or product liability preferred

• Juris Doctor or equivalent litigation experience is a plus

• Demonstrated authority and track record settling litigated BI and property claims

• Strong counsel-management, budgeting, and negotiation skills

• Ability to explain technical AV evidence clearly to counsel, mediators, and carriers

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent claims experience

• Active adjuster license(s) as required by the states handled, or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire

• Proficiency in the claims system, document management, and Microsoft Office

• Clear written and verbal communication with claimants, counsel, carrier

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one - who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Head of Engineering, you will lead Radiant's engineering organisation and be accountable for its execution, technical quality, reliability, and scalability.

You'll lead software engineering, platform security engineering, and architecture: an organisation of 30-35 engineers today, growing to 150 to 200+ as Radiant expands internationally. You'll partner closely with Product, the Customer team, Infrastructure, SRE, Operations, the PMO, and the wider technology leadership team.

This is a senior leadership role focused on building a high-performing engineering organisation capable of delivering and operating complex AI infrastructure at scale. You'll stay close to the work through design review.

- Own the engineering strategy, operating model, and execution in alignment with company and product objectives.

- Translate business priorities into clear technical plans, sequencing, investment decisions, and delivery commitments.

- Establish clear ownership, decision-making, and accountability across engineering teams.

- Drive predictable, high-quality delivery, identifying risk early and intervening where execution drifts.

- Ensure systems are designed and delivered to be production-ready, reliable, observable, maintainable, and supportable.

- Strengthen collaboration with infrastructure, SRE, and operations, including effective handover and incident learning.

- Set and uphold standards across architecture, engineering quality, security, scalability, and operational maturity.

- Own the roadmap jointly with Product: Product owns what is built, and you own how and when.

- Act as the senior escalation point for critical technical, architectural, and delivery decisions, brokering decisions between peers and escalating to the CTO when needed.

- Improve engineering maturity and processes while avoiding unnecessary bureaucracy or loss of delivery momentum.

- Represent engineering in executive and partner discussions, and join customer escalation reviews with the Customer team.

- Proven experience evolving a smaller engineering group into multiple teams with clear ownership, leadership, and consistent delivery.

- Experience designing organisational structures, team boundaries, and operating models for increasing scale and complexity.

- Demonstrated success improving delivery predictability, engineering quality, throughput, and organisational effectiveness.

title: Contract Marketing Strategist / Growth Marketing Consultant

We are looking for a marketing expert to help us improve how we market both Compose as a company and the individual products we build .

We already have some accounts and marketing efforts started, but we need someone who can help us organize everything, improve our strategy, create product-specific marketing pages and content direction, and teach our team how to think about marketing going forward.
This role is not just about posting on social media. We need someone who can help with strategy, messaging, setup, execution, and education.
You will help market both:

• Compose as a software development company

• Our products , such as Once Upon and future apps we build

Responsibilities

• Help define clear messaging for Compose and our products

• Create or improve product-specific social pages and content strategies

• Help set up, clean up, and organize Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, and related marketing channels

• Create a practical 3-month marketing plan

• Help us understand what content to post, where to post it, and why

• Advise on organic marketing, paid ads, influencer outreach, and community-based marketing

• Help us create repeatable marketing systems we can continue after the contract ends

• Help identify target audiences for Compose and individual products

• Review analytics and help us understand what is working

• Suggest improvements to landing pages, bios, profiles, ads, posts, and funnels

• Help us avoid wasting money on random ads or unfocused content

Ideal Candidate
You may be a strong fit if you:

• Have experience marketing software products, mobile apps, startups, SaaS, agencies, or digital services

• Understand social media strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, and similar platforms

• Can help with both brand-level marketing and product-specific marketing

• Know how to create practical, realistic marketing plans

• Can explain marketing concepts clearly to a technical team

• Understand organic content, paid ads, audience targeting, and funnel strategy

• Are comfortable working with a small team

• Can give direct feedback and help us prioritize what matters most

• Are strategic but also willing to help with hands-on execution

Nice to Have

• Experience marketing mobile apps

• Experience with AI products or consumer apps

• Experience with creator or influencer marketing

• Experience setting up Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, or Reddit Ads

• Experience with landing page copy and conversion optimization

• Experience working with small businesses, startups, agencies, or founder-led companies

What Success Looks Like After 3 Months
By the end of the engagement, we want to have:

• A clear marketing strategy for Compose

• A clear marketing strategy for at least one product, such as Once Upon

• Organized and improved social media accounts

• Product-specific pages and content direction

• A repeatable content plan

• A basic paid ads or campaign strategy, if appropriate

• Better understanding of who we are targeting and how to reach them

• A team that understands marketing better and can continue executing after the contract

Contract Details

• Contract length: 3 months

• Role type: Contractor / consultant

• Location: Remote

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.

At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

As Customer Care Associate, you will own customer issue resolution end to end and ensure distributors receive fast, reliable support in their day to day operations. You are accountable for ensuring customer order flow stays running and resolving customer issues as they arise.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Work through messy, time-sensitive issues (order errors, blocked accounts, product problems) to keep operations running smoothly

- Comfort operating across multiple tools and stakeholders in ambiguity and high-pressure situations

- Strong judgment in prioritization and real-time problem solving

- Accountability when things go wrong and the drive to resolve issues fully

- Native level of French speaking & writing is required

- Fluency in Spanish and English (C1+ written and spoken)

Working hours

This is a customer-facing operational role with fixed coverage requirements. You will work Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00, including a daily upaid lunch break. You must be consistently available during these hours to support customers across both Choco and Goot.

WHAT YOU GET

- Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

- Work with an AI product with proven product-market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

- Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

title: Senior Software Engineer - SRE
description:
When the Tarr Steps, a footbridge assembled of heavy stones in Exmoor National Park in England, washed away in a flood in 1942, the Royal Engineers rebuilt it. Then it washed away again in 1952. So the Royal Engineers heaved in more stones: on and on, like a Sisyphean lesson in absurdity.
Of course, they do this because the Tarr Steps are a historical monument, believed to be built during the Bronze Age. Modern bridge building looks a lot different and generally requires less upkeep. While we appreciate the charm of ancient things, Mercury is engineering the future of banking*. "Quaint" and "archaic" are not values we seek in our systems. Rebooting a tumbling server and hoping a flood of requests doesn't wash it away can be an emergency tactic, but we actively seek out durable solutions over monotonous ops work. You'll bring this ethos and teach others how to live it too.
Up to this point, the Stability team at Mercury has primarily built platform-level constructs that product teams adopt. However, those teams are asking for us to work more closely with them to mature their implementations and practices. We are creating an SRE team that will rotate through product teams. You will understand the team's domain, identify opportunities for improvements in reliability/observability/performance/preparedness and create self-reinforcing, virtuous cycles.
As part of this role, you will:

• Embed with product teams, helping them improve their operational maturity by setting up and refining practices around on-call, monitoring, alerting, and run books

• Run regular game day exercises with product teams, helping them feel more prepared to investigate and quickly remediate incidents

• Jump into application code written in Haskell & TypeScript and implement reliability techniques such as retries, better error handling, better logging, circuit breaking, etc

• Steer SLOs towards meaningful customer outcomes that product teams are accountable for. Those SLOs become a strong signal for whether the product is working as intended

• Champion reliability practices through design document and code reviews

• Identify observability gaps that hinder debugging, incident response, and business intelligence and help close those

• Advocate for longer-term improvements that non-product engineering teams can drive

• Participate in the product team's on-call rotation while embedding or as part of a more general engineering rotation, helping us improve processes and how we learn from incidents

The ideal candidate for the role:

• Has past Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps experience

• Has measurable examples of influencing an organization towards greater reliability

• Has significant experience with PostgreSQL

• Has authored and operated Temporal workflows

• Has experience with observability platforms like Grafana or Honeycomb

• Has familiarity with OpenTelemetry

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at .

title: Ingénieur Réseaux Électriques de Distribution - POC IA (CDI ou freelance)
description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités
Le POC réunit deux profils expérimentés et complémentaires : un ingénieur en réseaux électriques de distribution et un expert en IA. Le présent rôle porte sur l’expertise des réseaux de distribution et leur raccordement.

• Comprendre le contexte métier et les objectifs du POC.

• Accompagner les équipes métier dans la définition de leurs besoins et la priorisation des fonctionnalités à intégrer.

• Collaborer avec l’expert en IA et les équipes du projet.

• Définir, avec l’expert en IA, les solutions à prototyper et contribuer à leur conception.

📌 Le POC
Les congestions du réseau électrique et l’accès à la puissance, associés aux évolutions sectorielles et réglementaires, vont rendre plus complexe et plus dynamique la gestion des demandes de capacité de raccordement ainsi que l’octroi de ces capacités.
Le projet vise à explorer les possibilités offertes par l’intelligence artificielle afin de préparer de nouvelles méthodes de travail, de préciser les outils nécessaires à leur mise en œuvre et de disposer de métriques et de données utiles pour éclairer les décisions et étayer les positions dans les discussions sectorielles.
L’objectif est d’explorer, de tester et de simuler de manière itérative de nouvelles méthodes de gestion des demandes, de l’octroi et du suivi de l’utilisation des capacités de raccordement. Le POC prévoit notamment :

• La conception d’un parcours client cible intégrant les concepts déjà définis et ceux à préciser dans le cadre du programme.

• L’intégration de fonctionnalités et d’agents IA dans ce parcours client.

• La réalisation de tests et de simulations sur différentes étapes du parcours client, à partir de données réelles.

• L’analyse des résultats et l’identification des ajustements nécessaires.

La première phase sera consacrée au cadrage afin de :

• Prioriser les fonctionnalités et les cas d’usage.

• Identifier les ensembles de données nécessaires et exploitables.

• Valider les outils d’IA utilisés ainsi que l’environnement de test, en lien avec la gouvernance de l’IA.

Les résultats attendus sont des prototypes d’outils, des résultats de simulation et des recommandations en vue de l’adoption future de nouveaux parcours clients et des outils associés.
📝 Votre profil

• Expérience acquise auprès d’un gestionnaire de réseaux électriques de distribution, dans le domaine des études.

• Expérience dans la réalisation d’études de raccordement MT/BT et d’analyses d’impact sur le réseau.

• Maîtrise d’au moins un outil spécialisé de calcul et de simulation de réseaux électriques.

• Français de niveau C2.

• Expérience avec des systèmes GIS et des bases de données SQL pour exploiter des données de réseau ou de consommation.

• Expérience en conception ou en développement d’agents IA utilisant des LLM.

• Maîtrise d’au moins un langage de programmation, tel que Python, R ou Java, pour développer des solutions d’IA.

💼 Offre
Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.
(Freelance est également possible)

title: Partner Account Manager, Systems Integrators
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Partner Account Manager for Japan, you will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling strategic partnerships with both System Integrators (SIs) and resellers to accelerate the adoption of our solutions in the Japanese enterprise market. You will work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and Japan's unique business ecosystem, helping partners integrate our products into their solution portfolios and joint go-to-market strategies.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will focus on growing reseller business in Japan and achieving quarterly revenue targets through new customers and upsells. The position involves direct collaboration with partners and internal teams to overcome obstacles and implement growth strategies. Responsibilities include designing partner recruitment, enablement, and go-to-market plans, using a test-and-learn approach in ambiguous situations. Strong business creation skills are needed to identify joint value propositions and explore co-selling models. While revenue contribution is the key metric, building scalable partner engagement and executing joint initiatives are crucial for consistent growth.

This role is critical to establishing and expanding our presence in Japan through the partner ecosystem, enabling us to serve Japanese enterprises at scale. You will be instrumental in building our channel strategy from the ground up in one of the world's most sophisticated technology markets.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Partner Management

•
Develop and execute comprehensive business plans with System Integrators (NTT Data, Fujitsu, NEC, Hitachi, etc.) and key resellers to drive mutual growth and revenue targets

•
Build and maintain executive-level relationships within Japanese partner organizations, navigating complex organizational structures and decision-making processes

•
Own the full partner lifecycle from initial engagement through long-term strategic alignment, including regular business reviews and QBRs

•
Plan and deliver partner-facing activities, such as training sessions, email campaigns, webinars, and joint events

•
Negotiate and structure partnership agreements including technical integration terms, resale agreements, and revenue-sharing models

Business Development & Revenue Generation

•
Build and maintain relationships with reseller and distributor partners to drive new customer acquisition and upsell revenue

•
Collaborate with SI partners and resellers to identify, qualify, and close enterprise opportunities in key verticals (manufacturing, financial services, retail, telecommunications, life sciences)

•
Drive joint sales activities including customer workshops, seminars, proof-of-concepts, and strategic account planning 

•
Track pipeline development, forecast revenue, and report on partnership performance metrics with detailed accuracy

•
Manage channel conflict and ensure healthy ecosystem dynamics between direct sales, SI partners, and resellers

Enablement & Solution Development

•
Lead comprehensive enablement programs including technical training, certification development, and sales methodology alignment 

•
Work closely with partner practices to develop joint solutions and industry-specific offerings tailored to Japanese market requirements

•
Coordinate with global product and engineering teams to ensure Japanese partner requirements and customer feedback influence our roadmap

•
Develop and maintain Japanese-language sales tools, technical documentation, and partner portals

•
Facilitate knowledge transfer between Anthropic and Japanese partner technical teams

Go-to-Market Leadership

title: Event Manager
description:
L'équipe Marketing s'agrandit !

AssessFirst , en quelques mots 👇
Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale .
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays , pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.
Ce que tu feras :
Tu prends en main l'événementiel AssessFirst sur le marché français, de la première idée au debrief. Salons RH, conférences, événements physiques, dîners décideurs, webinars : tu conçois le plan, tu le produis, et tu mesures ce qu'il rapporte.
On cherche quelqu'un qui imagine des expériences dont nos invités parlent encore trois semaines après, et qui sait les transformer en rendez-vous et en opportunités pour nos commerciaux.
Tes missions :
Stratégie événementielle : construire et piloter le plan événementiel France, aligné sur les priorités commerciales. Choisir les salons et conférences à investir, créer nos propres événements, tester de nouveaux formats et arbitrer les opportunités entrantes (sponsoring, partenariats, prises de parole) selon leur potentiel business.
Production de bout en bout : prendre en charge toute la chaîne : brief, rétroplanning, prestataires, logistique, scénographie, contenus, présence sur site, clôture. Piloter les agences, lieux, traiteurs, stands et te constituer un réseau de partenaires fiables.
Activation et pipeline : construire avec les commerciaux le plan d'activation de chaque événement : qui inviter, comment, quels rendez-vous décrocher sur place, quel suivi après.
Budget et performance : gérer le budget événementiel France avec rigueur. Définir et suivre les KPI de chaque événement (leads qualifiés, rendez-vous, pipeline influencé, conversion, ROI), produire un debrief systématique et en tirer des recommandations concrètes pour le suivant.
Marque et contenus : faire des événements un relais de nos contenus et de notre marque, en lien avec l’équipe contenu.
Ta future équipe
Tu feras partie de l'équipe Marketing, organisée en cinq pôles : Growth, Content, Design & Brand, Field Marketing et Event.
Tu travailleras également en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales et partnership France.
Expérience souhaitée
Si tu ne coches pas toutes les cases mais que ce poste te parle, postule quand même. Recruter sur le potentiel, c'est notre métier.
🎪 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en event marketing, field marketing ou marketing B2B, idéalement en SaaS ou en environnement tech, avec des événements concrets à ton actif (salons, conférences, webinars).
📈 Une forte orientation business : tu comprends comment un événement nourrit un pipeline commercial et tu aimes travailler main dans la main avec les commerciaux.
🗂️ Une organisation sans faille : tu mènes plusieurs projets en parallèle sans perdre le fil.
🇬🇧 Tu es à l’aise pour communiquer ponctuellement en anglais dans un contexte professionnel.
Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?
Fourchette salariale : 45-50K + variable sur objectifs
Autonomie & flexibilité : tu t’organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.
Full remote : travaille d’où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍
Tickets resto : carte Swile à 10 € par jour travaillé.
Mutuelle : couverture santé avec Alan.
Épargne & participation : dispositif d’épargne salariale et de participation.
Bien-être : participation à tes activités sportives, chèques cadeaux et plateforme d’avantages.
Coworking : accès à des espaces partagés jusqu’à 5 fois par mois avec Worklib.
Vie d’équipe : une culture forte et trois séminaires par an pour se retrouver.
